CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA: feat(nock): glTF level importer (#462) + Blender-compat hardening of every glTF importer (#463). POST /admin/nock/api/shankpit-levels/import-gltf converts a Blender export to level walls/doors (stateless; the level editor merges them, one Undo step, 'glTF scale' control). Shared loader now takes a .gltf + sibling .bin (Blender 'glTF Separate', percent-encoded names), reads SHORT/BYTE + normalized accessors (KHR_mesh_quantization), refuses Draco/meshopt with a re-export hint, and returns errors instead of panicking on out-of-range bufferViews/buffers. Widget importer reuses the same upload reader. Tests added (nock + handlers). NOCK dist rebuilt; needs IDUNA rebuild+restart to serve. (sess-20260923-1030-4a526255)

⚓ ☃
